scope: EXP09 / issue #67: complete-cycle economics through the runner, evaluator, reports, owned workers and browser. Offline local implementation only.

checks.scenario: Original implementation and red-capable economics regressions
checks.expected: Baseline green; new coverage exposes missing integration
checks.observed: Original baseline: 321 tests / 1711 assertions. New tests failed on ignored wear allowance, unmatched-cycle handling and missing wear-adjusted fields before implementation.

applicability.reason: Historical baseline/red comparison only. Final-state checks below run against the implementation revision.

checks.scenario: Closed/open cycles, missing wear, repairs, unsold cargo, unmatched fuel, overlapping timelines, capital, forecasts, payback and listing reuse
checks.expected: Unknown inputs withhold normalized income/payback; meaningful values reach real report/evaluator/runner callers
checks.observed: 36 focused tests / 209 assertions passed. Includes actual synthetic command purchase for capital, retained cargo, owner rejection, integer validation and report-only HTTP comparisons.

checks.scenario: Full backend suite and CSRF boundary
checks.observed: 334 tests / 1799 assertions passed. New comparison route is included in the real request-forgery middleware regression. No failed/skipped test is reported.

checks.scenario: Pinned runtime, production assets, frontend invariants, style and whitespace
checks.expected: PHP 8.5.12 and pinned Node/pnpm; deterministic synchronized assets
checks.observed: Runtime preflight, negative runtime fixtures, two deterministic builds, saved-state/gameplay/timezone/ship/tutorial/guidance checks, script syntax, Pint and diff checks passed. Generated build matches the implementation commit.

checks.scenario: Finite workers, duplicate delivery, Stop, uncertain writes and process-death recovery
checks.expected: Owned SQLite/queue/locks; durable executor behavior preserved
checks.observed: MVP worker suite passed; staged automation worker suite passed complete and all four contract death/recovery cases. External provider was fake; local workers and persistence were real.

checks.scenario: Scout without wear, trade with entered wear, report/download, investment and throughput gates
checks.expected: Real handlers/workers persist results; unknown realized income and capital remain visible
checks.observed: Passed with no console/server errors. Trade cash 295 CR, explicit allowance 25 CR, net estimate 270 CR, realized rate null. Positive and buyer-constrained cases use incremental income. 1440/390 layouts remain dark under a light browser preference.

Desktop result clearly shows separate capital, current-assets rate, incremental rate, payback, ship-hours and throughput. Controls/text have readable contrast.
Narrow single-column result wraps all labels and values. Insufficient buyer capacity shows Unresolved with both payback values Unknown. No horizontal clipping in this result.

checks.scenario: Investigate, stage chosen wear, preview, stale-price rejection, real engine mining/contract, validation, Stop and session recovery
checks.expected: Versioned draft retains the allowance; open contracts do not claim comparable profit
checks.observed: Passed all seven journeys. Mining allowance 25 CR persisted and produced 215 CR estimated net from 240 CR cash. Contract cash 1300 CR remains unresolved for position/fuel. Screens checked at 1440/390/320; serviceRemoved=true, confirmed independently with launchctl print.

screenshots.inspection: Dark scrollable preview shows the entered 25 CR allowance, limits, trial warning and ordered actions. Labels wrap within the narrow panel; sticky dialog chrome remains visible.
Dark scrollable outcome shows 1300 CR cash, 25 CR allowance and 1275 CR after wear, while both comparable/realized rates remain Unknown. Open position and 100/95 fuel mismatch are visible.

checks.expected: No lock changes, platform mismatch or reported known vulnerabilities
checks.observed: Composer strict validation and platform checks pass. Composer audit and pnpm audit report no known vulnerabilities.

checks.scenario: Explain initial login HTTP 500 during concurrent asset builds
checks.expected: A reproducible verification-harness cause; stable assets produce successful login
checks.observed: Owned probe reproduced HTTP 500 with Vite manifest not found while rebuilding. Login was 200 before/after; final browser suites ran with stable assets and passed. Build output remained byte-identical to the implementation commit.

findings.summary: Cash-only runner totals and mining history ranking omitted a monetary wear basis
findings.evidence: Red regressions reproduced the missing allowance. Final backend, worker and browser checks prove the ledger reaches the actual callers.

findings.summary: New evidence reporting initially fetched reset-scoped fuel listings again
findings.evidence: OPT01 query-count tests failed. Report now reuses the supplied collection, including empty scopes; focused and full suites pass.

findings.summary: New reference selector and nested summaries required specific accessible targets
findings.evidence: Initial selector failures were reproduced and corrected with an explicit reference-control accessible name and scoped summary/staging locators. Both complete browser reruns pass.

findings.summary: Browser login overlapped temporary Vite manifest removal
findings.evidence: Controlled owned probe recorded ViteManifestNotFoundException and temporary 500 responses during build. Final validation serialized builds before browser work; stable login and full journeys pass.

limitations: No live SpaceTraders gameplay, paid APIs, spending, external notifications, deployment, push, remote merge, issue closure or PR metadata change.
External API responses, prices and yields are synthetic. Local HTTP handlers, SQLite persistence, queues, launchd engine and browsers were real; this does not prove live economic performance.
No independent review or security audit was requested/performed. No subagents were spawned. Remote CI remains unrun.
Inventory value after known fuel is a partial quote estimate; full remaining wear/selling costs, unpriced/excess cargo and imported or later unobserved equipment capital remain unknown.

Forecasts are disclosed observed sample envelopes, with no calibrated confidence or invented minimum-return policy. Fleet cases use entered assumptions and a bounded measured baseline; coordinated multi-ship gameplay remains separate.
Native hardware restore, long-run live operation, cross-device behavior and full screen-reader accessibility were not tested. Scrolling panel screenshots show the inspected scroll position.
Evidence is pinned to the implementation commit. The following evidence/documentation commit does not change runtime source or build assets.

Shared origin/main advanced eight documentation-only commits during the task, to 930e5bbc5aa83aa2c87c313ee6168206f08c4cb4. Runtime source equivalence was checked; this branch retains the requested 5c199069 base.
